description: This file defines the KmsClient class in the Aws\Kms namespace, which extends AwsClient. It provides method annotations for interacting with AWS Key Management Service (KMS), including key creation, deletion, encryption, decryption, and other cryptographic operations.

classes.name: KmsClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS KMS, extending AwsClient with methods for key management and cryptographic operations.

methods.name: cancelKeyDeletion
methods.description: Cancels the deletion of a customer master key (CMK).

methods.name: connectCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Connects to a custom key store.

methods.name: createAlias
methods.description: Creates a new alias for a customer master key.

methods.name: createCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Creates a new custom key store.

methods.name: createGrant
methods.description: Adds a grant to a customer master key.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Creates a new customer master key.

methods.name: deriveSharedSecret
methods.description: Derives a shared secret from a customer master key.

methods.name: describeCustomKeyStores
methods.description: Provides information about custom key stores.

methods.name: describeKey
methods.description: Provides information about a customer master key.

methods.name: disconnectCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Disconnects from a custom key store.

methods.name: generateDataKeyPairWithoutPlaintext
methods.description: Generates a data key pair without plaintext.

methods.name: generateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
methods.description: Generates a data key without plaintext.

methods.name: getKeyRotationStatus
methods.description: Gets the rotation status of a key.

methods.name: getParametersForImport
methods.description: Gets parameters for importing key material.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Retrieves the public key of a customer master key.

methods.name: listRetirableGrants
methods.description: Lists grants that can be retired.

methods.name: updateKeyDescription
methods.description: Updates the description of a key.

methods.name: updatePrimaryRegion
methods.description: Updates the primary region of a multi-region key.
